title: Cross-Task Transfer of Overseer Calibration: Train Overseer on Task A, Deploy on Task B

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Addresses whether oversight generalizes across tasks, which is relevant but somewhat operational. The safety chain goes through deployment efficiency rather than directly through safety failure modes.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires training an overseer on one task and deploying on another. Two different task setups needed. Moderate complexity for beginners but achievable with guidance.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two tasks, two training setups, one cross-task transfer comparison. Not overly broad but requires setting up two distinct evaluation pipelines. Feasible but not tight for 30 hours.
